T: You're so cool. So is this pie.
D: A comic shop clerk marries a call girl and the two go on the run to Hollywood with a suitcase they shouldn't have.
P: Serve the pie when Clarence and Alabama head to the diner after the kung fu triple feature.
S: the kung fu triple bill where Alabama spills her popcorn on Clarence
Popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed in melted butter and fine salt, a second batch tossed in butter, soy and a little sugar for the kung fu films. Served in big paper buckets.
Clarence's Detroit, before the road trip
Fine beef mince simmered with onion, chilli, cumin and paprika into a loose sauce, spooned over griddled cocktail franks in mini rolls, mustard and diced raw onion.
the comic book shop where Clarence works
Choux pastry with sharp cheddar and cayenne, piped into small rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow, served warm.
M: the purple convertible from Detroit to LA
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, American cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce in soft buns, wrapped in paper and eaten with the top down. Crinkle-cut fries.
the fancy LA hotel suite with the producer
Club sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo on three slices of toast, cut into triangles, with a silver bowl of shoestring fries.
W: pie after the movie, the night they meet
Sour cherries tossed with sugar, lemon, a splash of almond extract and cornflour, in a lattice-topped pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled before slicing. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the beach at the very end
45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime shaken hard with ice, strained into a salt-rimmed glass.

s.note: the kung fu triple bill where Alabama spills her popcorn on Clarence
s.how: Pop 150g kernels in coconut oil. Toss half with 30g butter and fine salt. Toss the rest with 30g butter melted with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sugar. Serve in big paper buckets for the triple feature.

s.note: the comic book shop where Clarence works
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs, 80g grated cheddar and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.

m.note: the fancy LA hotel suite with the producer
m.how: Grill 8 rashers bacon. Toast 12 slices white bread. Layer 300g roast chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo across three slices each and cut into triangles. Fry 1kg shoestring fries twice.

w.note: pie after the movie, the night they meet
w.how: Toss 800g sour cherries with 150g sugar, lemon juice, a drop of almond extract and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: the beach at the very end
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a salt-rimmed glass. Makes four. You're so cool.
